Main.sentence: Higher Ground Productions , also known simply as Higher Ground , is an American ___E:production company U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Production_company)___ which was founded in 2018 by former United States ___E:president U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/President_of_the_United_States)___ ___E:Barack Obama U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barack_Obama)___ and former ___E:First Lady U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/First_Lady_of_the_United_States)___ ___E:Michelle Obama U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Michelle_Obama)___ .

In May 2018, the Obamas launched Higher Ground Productions by signing a multi-year deal with ___E:Netflix U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Netflix)___ to produce scripted and unscripted film and television projects, with the goal of the company to lift up diverse voices in the entertainment industry.

Michelle Obama stated "I have always believed in the power of storytelling to inspire us, to make us think differently about the world around us, and to help us open our minds and hearts to others."  In February 2019, Priya Swaminathan, Tonia Davis, and Qadriyyah “Q” Shamsid-Deen joined the company, with Swaminathan and Davis serving as co-heads and Shamsid-Deen serving as a creative executive.
On June 6, 2019, ___E:Spotify U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spotify)___ announced a partnership with Higher Ground to produce Spotify-exclusive podcasts.
The first podcast under the partnership, The Michelle Obama Podcast , premiered on July 29, 2020.

The company's first film was American Factory , released in 2019. Netflix released Becoming a documentary following Michelle Obama on her book tour promoting ___E:her memoir of the same name U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Becoming_(book))___ .

Higher Ground has multiple projects in development, including a feature film adaptation of ___E:Frederick Douglass U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_Douglass)___ 's ___E:biography U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frederick_Douglass:_Prophet_of_Freedom)___ , a drama series set in the fashion scene of post-WWII New York City, and a scripted anthology series of the New York Times obituary column highlighting deaths of remarkable people not reported.

In June 2022, it was announced that Higher Ground would be ending its partnership with Spotify, as it signed a multi-year, multi-million-dollar deal with ___E:Audible U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audible_(service))___ .
In March 2025, the company announced that Michelle Obama and her brother Craig Robinson would launch a podcast called “IMO”.

In 2020, the company won an ___E:Academy Award U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Awards)___ for ___E:Best Documentary Feature Film U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Documentary_Feature_Film)___ and a ___E:Primetime Emmy Award U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Primetime_Emmy_Awards)___ for ___E:Outstanding Directing for a Documentary/Nonfiction Program U:(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Primetime_Emmy_Award_for_Outstanding_Directing_for_a_Documentary/Nonfiction_Program)___ for American Factory .
